Human-readable state, workflow, failure, command-envelope, and proof guidance.

knownTraps: A PowerShell prompt such as PS C:\Work\Repo> is terminal output, not part of the command; copying it causes PowerShell to resolve PS as the Get-Process alias.
A duplicated prompt can survive a visual scan and still turn the first token into Get-Process; validate the command block with Test-OperatorCommandEnvelope.ps1.
PowerShell continuation prompts, At line diagnostics, CategoryInfo, FullyQualifiedErrorId, and stderr text are evidence only and must never appear in executable blocks.
PSScriptRoot can be empty while a parameter default expression is evaluated in Windows PowerShell 5.1; resolve it in the script body.
System.String.Replace can bind to char,char when passed [char]0 and an empty string; force the string,string overload.
Hosted CI skips real WSL/Ubuntu runtime and cannot promote P00 workstation proof.
git diff may invoke an interactive pager; harness commands must use git --no-pager.
A stage may not pass from process creation alone; child exit, effective-state readback, and required observation remain mandatory.
Generated run evidence contains local account and path data and must remain untracked.
proofCeiling: Tracked harness structure, prompt-free registered operator command blocks, cross-shell parser and contract validation, fixture-safe CMD dispatch, local artifact policy, and exact failure-boundary reporting only. Live command execution, WSL initialization, visible WezTerm behavior, tmux attachment, agent launch, repeatability, and operator acceptance require the workstation live-cert sequence.
